# Security context answers

## Refund approvals

- Recommended answer: a manager must not approve a refund they requested.
- Answer: approved. The requester and approver must be different people.

## Invoice access

- Recommended answer: only the customer who placed an order may download its invoice.
- Answer: approved. Support staff may help with orders but may not download invoice PDFs because they contain payment details.

## Order cancellation

- Recommended answer: a customer may cancel only their own placed order; support may cancel an order for support purposes.
- Answer: approved.
